title: 历史月度趋势
query: 只查询 askdata_mock：查询2026年6月和7月各月实付金额合计，月份显示为YYYY-MM，不额外筛选状态。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: SELECT strftime(orders_history.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS "月份", SUM(orders_history.paid_amount) AS "实付金额合计" FROM orders_history WHERE orders_history.order_date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND orders_history.order_date < DATE '2026-08-01' GROUP BY strftime(orders_history.order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY "月份"
